name: Austin Delic
headline: Founding Engineer | Software, Backend & Systems

bullets: Contributed across a production healthcare payments platform: Angular web apps, NativeScript mobile, .NET APIs, SQL Server and Azure services.
Worked on authentication, payments, REST/OpenAPI contracts, EF Core data access and background jobs; supported Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker publishing and AKS deployments.
Designed, built and maintained full-stack client applications serving hundreds of active users across Australia's eastern states.
Owned requirements, implementation, deployment and support, working directly with clients to deliver updates.
Built and maintained a production CRM with Next.js, React and PostgreSQL, owning schema design, UI development and iterative feature delivery.

projects.name: Tactify
bullets: Built at Perth Hackerhouse: converts visual learning materials into tactile-ready SVG graphics and guided audio narration for blind and low-vision users.
Implemented a Next.js/React interface, Go backend, protobuf APIs and Gemini, ImageMagick, vtracer and text-to-speech pipeline.

projects.name: Still
bullets: Built a Rust project environment manager with typed configuration, lockfiles and CLI/TUI frontends over a shared async engine; implemented install planning, rollback-aware state recording and SHA-256 trust checks.
